info.title: Thriving in Tech LMS Foundation API
info.description: FR01 and FR02 foundation plus FR03 course shells. Local mailbox and Resend email transports. Remaining MVP modules are not implemented.

get.description: MVP foundation. Public account or health endpoint. Does not query the database. Application limit: 300 requests per IP per minute; health endpoints are exempt.
MVP foundation. Public account or health endpoint. Returns 503 if database connectivity fails. Application limit: 300 requests per IP per minute; health endpoints are exempt.

post.summary: Register a student or pending lecturer
post.description: MVP foundation. Public account or health endpoint. Registration and duplicate registration return the same generic response. No session, verification token, or password is returned. Lecturer roles remain pending approval. Authentication endpoints share a limit of 20 attempts per IP per 15 minutes. Other application requests share 300 requests per IP per minute. Writes require an allowed Origin. Validation rejects unknown fields. Cookie credentials require the browser credentials option.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must exactly match an origin in FRONTEND_ORIGINS.
